March 21, 1991

Mr. Pat Stokes
President
Anheuser-Busch, Inc.
One Busch Place
St. Louis, Missouri

Dear Mr. Stokes:

We were delighted that our introductory meeting in St. Louis went so well and that there appears to be a basis for information and experience sharing which may lead to further areas of cooperation.

As we begin the first phase of our relationship, we think it important that we agree on some fundamental principles -- principally, relating to confidentiality. Each of us should impress the following upon those of our colleagues who will be involved in the initial or subsequent areas of cooperation:

• We endorse the process and believe it important;

- Both the fact that we are cooperating and all details related to that cooperation shall not be disclosed to anyone other than on a "need-to-know" basis; and

• Each of us shall establish and maintain security procedures with respect to information provided by the other which are at least as strict as those utilized by
